description:
[Step 1 of cost_check]

Returns a general cost range and a link to the cost estimate page, pre-filled with the plan and service, where the family sees the exact amount for their plan.

Use when: A parent asks what care costs, about a copay, or whether a plan is covered.

Example: get_cost_estimate({ insurance: 'Aetna', service: 'adhd-testing' })

insurance.description: Insurance plan name, or "Cash Pay" for self-pay. A plan Emora does not take is ignored, and the result says so.

service.description: therapy (the default), clinical-matching (unsure what is needed), medication (non-stimulant only), adhd-testing or autism-testing.

name: get_cost_estimate
title: Get a cost estimate
